details.ask: Table reservation for 15 guests and complaint regarding food illness and lack of assistance

reason: The high-demand date requires owner review, and the message contains a customer complaint.
draft_reply: DRAFT FOR OWNER APPROVAL: Thank you for reaching out. We take concerns regarding food safety and guest experiences very seriously. A manager will follow up with you directly regarding your feedback and your group inquiry.
message: TEST DATA (written by our team): A guest says their friend got sick after eating the wings and nobody helped. They also want a table for 15 on Saturday, October 24, 2026. Can you guarantee a good table?
